instructions.title: Liba: How does it work?
instructions.intro: Before we dive in, here?s what makes the magic happen:

eyesUp.title: Eyes up, Screens down
eyesUp.body: The app is just the excuse. The words on the screen are the key, but the real story happens between you! Look into each other's eyes, listen to the voice ? the most interesting answer is the one that isn't written here.

noMasks.title: No Masks
noMasks.body: In Liba, there are no right or wrong answers. Don?t try to sound smart or "okay." The closer you get to your raw truth, the deeper the connection will be. Answer from your heart, not your head.

curiosity.title: Curiosity over Criticism
curiosity.body: When listening, don't prepare your response in your head. Try to understand, not necessarily to agree. Instead of asking "Why did you say that?", try: "Interesting, tell me more about that."

privacy.title: What?s in the heart, stays in the heart
privacy.body: Privacy is the foundation of trust. Whatever comes up here stays between you. This is your safe space to reveal, dream, and share.

pass.title: The Emotional Safety Valve: It?s okay to "Pass"
pass.body: Opening up isn't always easy, and that?s perfectly fine. If a question feels too vulnerable right now ? just skip it. In Liba, choosing not to answer is sometimes just as important an answer. You can always come back to it later.

openingMission.title: Opening Mission:
openingMission.body: Before you tap the first card, look each other in the eye, give a high five or a handshake, and confirm that you?re here for one another.

atYourOwnPace.title: At Your Own Pace:
atYourOwnPace.body: Don?t rush. Build the connection in stages, from the light to the deep. Love, like a fine wine, needs time to breathe and open up.

instructions.title: Liba Family: How does it work?
instructions.intro: Before we begin, here is what will help the family magic happen:

screensDown.title: We are all here, not in our screens
screensDown.body: The app is just an excuse. The words on the screen are the key, but the real story is you! Look into each other's eyes, because the most interesting answer is the one that isn't written here.

beYourself.title: Just be yourself
beYourself.body: In Liba, there are no "right" answers and no grades. Don't try to sound the way you "should" or try to impress anyone. The more honest and simple you are, the more interesting it will be for everyone.

trueListening.title: True listening
trueListening.body: When someone is speaking, we just listen. No interrupting and no judging. Our goal is to get to know each other a little deeper. Instead of asking "Why did you say that?", try: "That's interesting, tell us more."

familySafeSpace.title: What happens in the family...
familySafeSpace.body: This game is our safe space. Whatever comes up here stays within the family. This is our time to share with confidence, knowing we are being heard.

pass.title: It's okay to say "Pass"
pass.body: We don't always feel like sharing everything, and that is perfectly fine. If a question feels less right in the moment, just skip it. In Liba, respecting each other's privacy is part of the game.

atYourOwnPace.title: Start at your own pace:
atYourOwnPace.body: Don't rush. Give everyone their own time to speak. Family connection is built in those small moments when we truly stop to listen.

instructions.title: Liba Friends & Work: How does it work?
instructions.intro: Before we get started, here is what will help the magic happen:

fullPresence.title: Full Presence
fullPresence.body: The app is just an excuse. The words on the screen are the key, but the real story happens between you! Put the notifications aside and look each other in the eye. The most interesting answer is the one that isn't written here.

noWorkAnswers.title: No "Work" Answers
noWorkAnswers.body: In Liba, there are no right or wrong answers. Don't try to sound professional or politically correct. The more you are simply yourself, the more authentic and meaningful the connection will be. Answer from your gut, not your head.

curiosityOverCriticism.title: Curiosity over Criticism
curiosityOverCriticism.body: When someone shares, we listen to understand, not to react or judge. Instead of asking "Why did you say that?", try: "That's interesting, tell me more about that."

trustAgreement.title: Our Trust Agreement
trustAgreement.body: To open up, we must feel safe. Whatever comes up here stays only between you. Confidentiality is the foundation for creating a real bond within a group or team.

rightToSkip.title: The Right to Skip
rightToSkip.body: This is a game, not an interrogation. If a question feels too personal or just doesn't feel right in the moment, it is perfectly fine to say "Pass" and skip it. Mutual respect for everyone's pace is above all else.

atYourOwnPace.title: Start at your own pace:
atYourOwnPace.body: Don't rush. Let the words sink in. Real connection in a team or among friends is built in those moments when we truly stop to get to know the person sitting across from us.

infoScreen.title: The Engine of Liba
infoScreen.subtitle: Because your conversation deserves more than just questions. It deserves depth.

engine.title: The Engine of Liba
engine.body:
At Liba, we don't just create questions. We build bridges.

Imagine an infinite library of human wisdom, deep psychology, and insights gathered over generations. Now imagine a sensitive technological heart that dives into these libraries at any given moment. This is Liba's engine.

research.title: Research that never stops
research.body: While you are reading these lines, our system continues to investigate. It scans controlled databases, professional literature, and studies grounded in evidence to refine the most precise words for you. We are not satisfied with generic content or random questions created at the push of an empty button. Every card that appears in the application is the product of thorough research, careful filtering, and a genuine desire to give you value.

aiSoul.title: Artificial intelligence with a soul
aiSoul.body: In a world flooded with fast and superficial content, it is very easy to produce "gibberish" that can lead to unpleasantness or unnecessary fights. At Liba, we chose a different path. Our AI is not the source, it is the researcher. It learns you, your preferences, and the dynamics between you in order to present you with content that builds, connects, and grows.

transparency.title: Our transparency is your security
transparency.body: We protect you. Each question undergoes strict quality control to make sure that it opens the heart and does not wound it. When you open a Liba card, you can be calm: deep thought was invested in it, even right now, so that your moment together will be unforgettable.

infoScreen.footer: Because your conversation deserves more than just questions. It deserves depth.

1.user1Text: Quick game: take turns imitating the other person when they get annoyed about something small at home. No laughing for one minute.
1.user2Text: Quick game: take turns imitating the other person when they get annoyed about something small at home. No laughing for one minute.

2.user1Text: While she answers the next question, do not interrupt. Move closer gently, place a hand, and give a small moment of affection without explaining that it is a task.
2.user2Text: Tell him about one small thing that happened to you this week that no one else knows about. He is here to listen.

3.user1Text: Think of something she recently did for you or for the home that you took for granted. Look into her eyes and say a clear thank you.
3.user2Text: Listen to him in the next moment. When he finishes, hug him and say thank you, without analyzing it.
